li.label: my lucky {ITEM}
li.description: Nothing bad happens while I have it on me. That's just a fact.

li.label: without my lucky {ITEM}
li.description: Where is it? I don't feel right without it. Something's going to go wrong.

li.label: storms mean death
li.description: There was thunder like this the night we lost them. I've counted every flash since it started.

li.label: night prayers
li.description: I say my prayers every night now, the same words each time. Sleep comes easier after.

li.label: afraid of the dark
li.description: Ever since I lay there unable to move, I can't stand the dark.

li.label: battle ritual
li.description: Touch the doorframe, check the weapon twice, say the name. Then I'm ready.

li.label: the sun has gone out
li.description: I dreamt the sun would go out, and now it has. I know what it means.

li.label: the rain washes it away
li.description: It's raining, so I went out and stood in it until I was soaked to the skin. That's better.

li.label: under the open sky
li.description: I lay on the ground once thinking it was the last sky I'd see. Now I go and look at it whenever I can.

li.label: winter remembers
li.description: Snow on the ground, and I'm thinking about them again. It'll be like this until the thaw.
